description.raw: '''Innate:''' '''Pyke's''' [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] '''maximum''' health cannot increase except through [[Growth#Increasing_Statistics|growth (per level)]], instead he gains「 [[File:Attack damage icon.svg|15px|link=Attack damage]] 1 '''bonus''' attack damage per 14 '''bonus''' health. 」「 [[File:Attack damage icon.svg|15px|link=Attack damage]] '''bonus''' attack damage equal to 7.143% of '''bonus''' health. 」
description.text: Innate: Pyke's  maximum health cannot increase except through growth (per level), instead he gains「  1 bonus attack damage per 14 bonus health. 」「  bonus attack damage equal to 7.143% of bonus health. 」

description2.raw: '''Innate:''' '''Pyke''' gains 1 '''bonus''' movement speed while in the river.
description2.text: Innate: Pyke gains 1 bonus movement speed while in the river.

description3.raw: '''Innate:''' '''Pyke''' stores 9% (+ 0.2% per 1 Lethality) of the post-mitigation damage he takes from enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]] as [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] on his [[health bar]], increased to 40% (+ 0.4% per 1 Lethality) while there are two or more [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|visible]] enemy champions nearby. He can store up to 80 (+ 800% '''bonus''' AD) [[Health#Grey health|grey health]], with an upper cap of 55% of his '''maximum''' health.
description3.text: Innate: Pyke stores 9% (+ 0.2% per 1 Lethality) of the post-mitigation damage he takes from enemy champions as grey health on his health bar, increased to 40% (+ 0.4% per 1 Lethality) while there are two or more visible enemy champions nearby. He can store up to 80 (+ 800% bonus AD) grey health, with an upper cap of 55% of his maximum health.

description4.raw: While '''Pyke''' is not [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|visible]] to enemies, he rapidly consumes his [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] to [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|heal]] for the same amount.
description4.text: While Pyke is not visible to enemies, he rapidly consumes his grey health to heal for the same amount.

notes.raw:
* Game elements that increase health based on the champion's health (e.g [[File:Overgrowth rune.png|20xpx|link=Overgrowth|An icon representing Overgrowth]] [[Overgrowth]]) will increase the health before getting converted by ''Gift of the Drowned Ones'', thus granting increased bonus AD. * Pyke converts bonus health to bonus AD at a gold efficiency of 93.75%. * [[File:Spirit Visage item.png|20xpx|border|link=Spirit Visage|An icon for the item Spirit Visage]] [[Spirit Visage]] and [[File:Grievous Wounds icon.png|20px|link=Grievous Wounds|An icon representing the keyword Grievous wounds]] [[:Grievous Wounds|Grievous Wounds]] take effect after ''Gift of the Drowned Ones's'' healing cap. *'''Pyke's''' ''grey health'' does not have a time limit, and will stay on his health bar until '''Pyke''' leaves enemy vision or dies. ** However, if his combined '''current''' health and ''grey health'' would start to exceed 100% of his '''maximum''' health, the excess ''grey health'' is lost. * Since '''Pyke's''' '''maximum''' health cannot be increased, ''Gift of the Drowned Ones'' reaches the upper cap of 55% of '''maximum''' health at 40.25 – 202.49 (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] '''bonus''' attack damage. * [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|Untargetable]] champions count towards '''Pyke's''' modified ''grey health'' storing. * Amount of attack damage granted from list of items that grants health, converted with ''Gift of the Drowned Ones'': This table is automatically generated based on the data from [https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Module:ItemData/data?action=edit Module:ItemData/data].

notes.text:
Game elements that increase health based on the champion's health (e.g Overgrowth) will increase the health before getting converted by Gift of the Drowned Ones, thus granting increased bonus AD.
Pyke converts bonus health to bonus AD at a gold efficiency of 93.75%.
Spirit Visage and Grievous Wounds take effect after Gift of the Drowned Ones's healing cap.
Pyke's grey health does not have a time limit, and will stay on his health bar until Pyke leaves enemy vision or dies.
* However, if his combined current health and grey health would start to exceed 100% of his maximum health, the excess grey health is lost.
Since Pyke's maximum health cannot be increased, Gift of the Drowned Ones reaches the upper cap of 55% of maximum health at 40.25 – 202.49 (based on level)Category:Debug bonus attack damage.
Untargetable champions count towards Pyke's modified grey health storing.
